lesson: The system is consistently attempting to fade liquidity sweeps in a strong trending market, resulting in 10 consecutive stop-outs as price fails to initiate reversals. The reliance on low-confidence, low-win-probability setups against the prevailing daily trend has led to constant 'catching a falling knife' scenarios.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'Trend-Filter' rule: only execute trades that align with the 4H EMA trend, ignoring all counter-trend liquidity sweeps until a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or Change of Character (CHoCH) occurs on the 1H timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps LESS; prioritize structural trend alignment over localized exhaustion signals.
